title: Unable to select sounds for Extra Alerts features
body:
### Environment
Xdrip+ c98a3c4 2021.10.17

Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 pro running Android 11 Miui 12
Xiaomi Redmi Note 10 pro running Android 11 Miui 12

Issue exists for quite long time so applies to old release as well.

### Actual behavior
When clicking on 'Persistent High Sound' and 'Predicted Low Sound' menus, application hangs and returns to main graph menu without presenting the list for selecting a system sound.

This seems to be related to the Android function allowing access to file system, as it works correctly on a Samsung S7 device running Android 7

### Expected behaviour
Application unable then to play sound for preventive low and persistent high alerts

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
Go to Settings > Extra Alerts (xDrip+)
Select "Persistent High Sound" or
Select "Predictive Low Sound"

This seems to be related to the Android function allowing access to file system, as it works correctly on a Samsung S7 device running Android 7
